## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jun 11, 2026 - Aug 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jess_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "can't cancel subscription"
            2. _written11_, Jun 11, 2026, 3/5: "It’s a great app and I definitely recommend it to anyone who is motivated by gamification. It’s a little confusing to navigate at first, but great once you get the hang of it. However if you want to collect all the pets and such, you have no choice but to subscribe. Pet quests can be gained if you join a party with people who have subscriptions, but for pets that can’t be obtained through quests you’re basically screwed. Challenges can give you gem rewards, but chances of winning are very slim. I would love if gems were purchasable with coins but were very expensive per gem to encourage people to either grind for them or subscribe. That being said I can see how that could be abused with FCV and spamming habits, so if that were implemented those things would need to be adjusted and capped. But I do think it’s doable and less scammy, and honestly a more motivating option. I’ve fallen off Habitica a lot because when those things are unattainable there’s little incentive to actually use the app TL;DR: Good app overall but in my opinion the motivating factors are not sustainable. Claims not to be a pay to win game but absolutely is one if you want to collect things, which is the main reward system of the game. Needs adjustments"
            3. _AKpopFan420_, Jul 16, 2026, 4/5: "I crashed out from the penalties when having a tough time and ended up uninstalling it for almost 3 years but i’m back because it’s the only task manager that’s actually worked on me. Just wish certain things werent blocked by paywall"
<!--/ir-theme-->
